_note: Build spec for the Shopify Flow template gallery entry. Flow templates are created in the Flow editor and submitted from the Partner Dashboard; this file is the definition to build from, not an import file. The trigger and action extensions are created with `shopify app generate extension` (types Flow Trigger and Flow Action); the TOML below is the starting point and the handles must match the Worker.
name: Hold high-risk orders for review (RelayShield)
description: When RelayShield screens an order as high risk, hold it before shipping so the merchant can review it.

steps.note: Holds the fulfillment order (HIGH_RISK_OF_FRAUD). Never cancels or refunds.

steps.subject: RelayShield held order {{ order_id }} (score {{ Risk score }})

extension_toml_trigger:
[[extensions]]
name = "High-risk order screened"
type = "flow_trigger"
handle = "relayshield-high-risk-order"
description = "Fires when RelayShield screens an order as high risk or holds it."

[settings]
  [[settings.fields]]
  type = "order_reference"
  description = "The screened order."

  [[settings.fields]]
  type = "number_decimal"
  key = "Risk score"

  [[settings.fields]]
  type = "single_line_text_field"
  key = "Risk level"

  [[settings.fields]]
  type = "single_line_text_field"
  key = "Top signal"
extension_toml_action:
[[extensions]]
name = "Hold order for review"
type = "flow_action"
handle = "relayshield-hold-order"
description = "Holds the order's fulfillment for merchant review. Never cancels or refunds."
runtime_url = "/flow/hold-order"

[settings]
  [[settings.fields]]
  type = "order_reference"
  key = "Order"
  description = "The order to hold."
